 About José Luis Guzmán Mansilla
 CountrySpain
 Recorded matches96
 Available seasons2022/2023 – 2026/2027
 Competitions3
 José Luis Guzmán Mansilla, born on November 2, 1995 in Jaén, Andalusia, is a Spanish referee currently officiating in the Segunda División of Spain. He belongs to the Andalusian Referees Committee and has been climbing categories since his debut in Segunda División B in the 2016-2017 season. In the 2022-2023 season, he was promoted to the Segunda División, where he has refereed more than 40 matches to date.At 29 years old, Guzmán Mansilla is considered a young but experienced referee. His refereeing style is characterized by being strict in the application of the regulations, which is reflected in his average number of cards shown per match.Throughout his career, he has maintained a reputation for being a disciplined and methodical referee, which has allowed him to establish himself in the Segunda División of Spain since the 2022-2023 season.
